answer: An attacker who tries to forge thousands of fake identities must pay that compute cost per puppet and mirror the same stake, so mass duplication becomes economically irrational while honest agents pay once. Sybil resistance comes from bonding identity to scarce, verifiable work: each agent must submit a signed proof-of-compute challenge whose solution requires burning real cycles, and peers cross-check it against a falcon-signed attestation chain. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
